alt: STEP 1 OF 10: Choose a package — Starter, Plus, or Custom based on what you need.
STEP 2 OF 10: Submit requirements — Fill out the Get Started form with your details.
STEP 3 OF 10: Payment — Confirm your order to begin work.
STEP 4 OF 10: Content collection — Send your text, images, logo, and links.
STEP 5 OF 10: Development — Your website is built using our template system.
STEP 6 OF 10: Customer review — You review the site and request revisions.
STEP 7 OF 10: Updates & revisions — We adjust the site based on your feedback.
STEP 8 OF 10: Deployment — The website is published and made live.
STEP 9 OF 10: Delivered — Your website is online and ready to share.
STEP 10 OF 10: Free update period — Your package's free update window begins.
